content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Event Registration Submission Process ## slug: event-registration-submission-process ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Warning) (**ERS Job Update**) The Blackthorn | Event Registration Processing job will not be scheduled automatically in a sandbox after production is refreshed. Event Registration Submission (ERS) records will not process until this is resolved. To solve this, click the **Schedule Recommended Event Jobs** button. Click [here](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/scheduled-batch-jobs-events#blackthorn-events-registration-processing){target=`_blank`} to learn more about the Blackthorn | Events Registration Processing scheduled job. ::: The {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} object is a container that holds a large amount of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registration information until the system is ready to process everything in the object. This object is important because if an ERS fails, you will be able to figure out why and be able to fix the problem, so your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}(s) receives their confirmation email. There are multiple benefits for using the ERS object. • Provides a better {{glossary.user experience}} for your {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s. • Prevents the loss of registration data or payments. • Helps troubleshoot issues. ![Overview: ERS](https://youtu.be/QgMrqu7vrbs){height="480" width="640"} ## Navigate the ERS Record 1. Click on the **App Launcher** icon. 2. Type "Events (Admin)" and select the Events (Admin) app. 3. Click the {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} tab. The registration records from every {{variable.Object_Event}} are located here. If you haven’t run any {{variable.Object_Event}}s yet, you won’t see a record yet. To see an example, register for one of the sample {{variable.Object_Event}}s and then come back. Here is an example of an {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} record. All {{variable.Object_Attendee}} data will be saved here including names, emails, tickets selected, etc. ![ers process 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/ers%20process%201.png){height="" width=""} ### Character Limitations The max character limit for the {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} {{variable.Field_ERS_FormJSON}} field is 131,000 characters. You may run into a Salesforce limit for the ERS Payload when simultaneously registering a large group of {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s with long {{variable.Object_Form}}s or one or more {{variable.Object_Form}}s with many {{variable.Object_FormElement}}s. To prevent this error, be aware of the number of {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s added to one registration and the size of the {{variable.Object_Form}}(s) used. ## Fix a Failed ERS Record Here is an example of a failed {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} record. ![ers process 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/ers%20process%202.png){height="" width=""} * * * To fix the problem, complete the steps below. 1. Identify and fix the issue defined in the {{variable.Field_ERS_ErrorMessage}} field. 2. Update the {{variable.Field_ERS_Status}} field from “Failed” to “To Process”. 3. Empty the {{variable.Field_ERS_ErrorMessage}} and {{variable.Field_ERS_AttendeeJSON}} fields. 3. Set the {{variable.Field_ET_ERS_Process}} field to "True" (checked). 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. This will reprocess the {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} record and create the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record. ![ers process 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/ers%20process%204.png){height="" width=""} ## Batch Processing Since we fire several batch/queue jobs simultaneously, we can’t guarantee which one will be the last to finish. The following list includes jobs as they are added to the queue. * Populate some {{variable.Object_Attendee}} fields based on {{variable.Object_Account}}/{{variable.Object_Contact}}. * {{variable.Object_EventItem}} quantities rollup to {{variable.Object_Event}}s. * Add {{variable.Object_Attendee}}s to the webinar, when needed. * Create a {{variable.Object_CampaignMember}}, when needed. * Send registration emails. * Recalculate {{variable.Object_Session}} capacities. * {{variable.Object_SessionAttendee}} rollup to {{variable.Object_Session}}/{{variable.Object_Event}}. * {{variable.Object_ET_FormSubmission}} processing. * Capture and update {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s, if already authorized. To prevent issues with {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} processing during times of high concurrent registrations, automatically scheduled ERS batch processing from the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} page will occur. The Blackthorn | Event Registration Processing job will run every one minute. Since ERS records are processed in batches, there may be a delay of up to one minute before a record is processed. A protected custom setting with a default value at "Off" was added and can only be changed from the {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} page. (The public custom setting has been deprecated.) ### Turn Custom Setting On 1. Return to {{variable.Tab_ET_BTEventAdmin}} page. 2. Click {{variable.Button_ET_ScheduledJobs}} and view the available jobs, including "Process Event Registration in Batches". ![EventAdminTabScheduledJob_ERSBatchProcessing](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/EventAdminTabScheduledJob_ERSBatchProcessing_022323.png){height="" width=""} ## Email Alert for Failed Registrations ### Important Prerequisite The “Blackthorn | Events ERS Failed” workflow rule was deprecated and replaced with the “Blackthorn | Events ERS Failed” flow. When you upgrade Events to Version x.x, the deprecated workflow rule will be active (unless you have previously deactivated it), AND the new flow will also be active. This occurs because Blackthorn cannot update the state/status of an existing workflow rule in a customer’s org. Your Admin must deactivate the workflow rule; otherwise, Salesforce will send two emails to the Admin with information about the ERS error. ### Update the Email Alert Recipient The “Blackthorn | Events ERS Failed” (Blackthorn_Events_ERS_Failed) flow is enabled by default. It sends the user who authorized the Events app an email when an ERS record fails. If you want to change who receives the notification, complete the steps below. 1. Go to Setup. 2. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Email Alerts." 3. Select the "ERS Failed Email" email alert. 5. Click {{variable.Button_SF_Edit}}. 6. Update the recipients or enter an additional email. ## Order of Execution When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} checks out for an {{variable.Object_Event}}, many records are created and updated automatically. The flow below provides insight into the execution order, so you know when to interact with the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object for your custom processes and flows. ### Attendee Data 1. An {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record is created. * The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record relates to the {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, or {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} and the {{variable.Object_Event}}. * Registration Status is set to "Registered". 2. Answers to custom questions are processed through the {{variable.Object_ET_FormSubmission}} object and related to the {{variable.Object_Attendee}}. 3. {{variable.Object_Invoice}} & {{variable.Object_LineItem}} are created. 4. The {{variable.Object_Contact}}, {{variable.Object_Lead}}, {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}}, {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_Status}} field, {{variable.Field_PTInvoice_SubjectLine}} field, and additional fields are set on the {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. ### Paid Events 1. The card information is sent immediately to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. A token is received (PCI compliant). 2. The completed {{variable.Object_Transaction}} and {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} are saved in Salesforce. Initially, they are orphan records because the {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} hasn't processed to connect the payment with the registration {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. 3. Once the ERS is processed, the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is updated with the related {{variable.Object_Invoice}}. ## ERS Record Statuses * "Draft" = This is used when the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has not completed checkout. Draft records are created in two scenarios: running a validation and entering a discount code. The draft can then be updated for submission if the user completes the checkout process. * "To Process" = This is used when checkout is complete and the record is submitted for processing. * "Failed" = This is used when there is an issue submitting the ERS record. * "Completed" = This is used when the ERS record is processed successfully.
